newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Friday.

"Rates were a little bit mixed in the morning on some position adjustments. There wasn't much activity today as most people have squared or are squaring their positions for the weekend," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for Monday's issue of the Federal Budget and Tuesday's release of the consumer confidence index figures, for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend and Monday/Tuesday were unchanged from Thursday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.
Week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point to 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Thursday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16, six-months rose 1/16 point to 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent.
